'''Century Lane''' was an area in [[Worlport/Legends|Worlport]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. The [[Casino/Legends|casino]] [[Throw Me a Bone/Legends|Throw Me a Bone]] was located on Century Lane.<ref name="Edge of the Empire">[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]]</ref>
